agreement_3class.note: reference mapped to a band: supported->grounded, partially_supported->inferred, unsupported/contradicted->uncertain

band_minus_random.note: negative means the band's risk is lower than the baseline's at matched coverage; the gap is computed per answer and the interval is a paired cluster bootstrap over answers

band_minus_shortest.note: negative means the band's risk is lower than the baseline's at matched coverage; the gap is computed per answer and the interval is a paired cluster bootstrap over answers

band_minus_longest.note: negative means the band's risk is lower than the baseline's at matched coverage; the gap is computed per answer and the interval is a paired cluster bootstrap over answers

band_minus_first.note: negative means the band's risk is lower than the baseline's at matched coverage; the gap is computed per answer and the interval is a paired cluster bootstrap over answers

band_vs_random.k: half the claims of each answer
band_vs_random.note: a negative difference means the band kept fewer wrong claims than the baseline at the same k

band_vs_shortest.k: half the claims of each answer
band_vs_shortest.note: a negative difference means the band kept fewer wrong claims than the baseline at the same k

band_vs_longest.k: half the claims of each answer
band_vs_longest.note: a negative difference means the band kept fewer wrong claims than the baseline at the same k

band_vs_first.k: half the claims of each answer
band_vs_first.note: a negative difference means the band kept fewer wrong claims than the baseline at the same k

position_length_confound.note: a negative correlation means later claims are shorter, so position and length are not the same policy; a positive one means they are

circularity_audit.note: the shipped rate counts a claim as a hallucination when the NLI does not entail it over the retrieved passages; the reference rate counts it when an independent judge reading the evidence this run used does not find the claim supported. The two are not the same measurement, and the gap between them is the size of the circularity.

answer_level.note: an answer with no grounded claim at all is vacuously clean under the grounded-only rule; the claim share is reported alongside so the rate is not read on its own

band_definitions.framework: noisy-OR of the per-chunk entailment probabilities over the retrieved passages (src/claims.py::assess_claims). This is the band the answer shows the practitioner.
band_definitions.experiment: maximum entailment over the same candidates, thresholded at 0.5 (run_generation_eval.py::_claim_support). This is the claim-support rate the papers report.
band_definitions.note: the two are different functions of the same evidence. The noisy-OR assumes the witnesses fail independently, which they do not -- ten passages about the same subject are not ten independent trials -- so it saturates where the maximum does not.
